integrity: Algebraic proof and independently coded exact enumeration checks are included; verification is not independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform ordered positive compositions conditional on fixed sum and fixed number of parts; nonuniform, circular or higher-moment extensions are unproved. An earlier 1998 original was not available in full text, so historical priority remains subject to independent scrutiny.
title: Complete covariance-sign classification for unit parts and adjacent equalities in uniform compositions
